findings.must_convey: getProject accepts workspaceId but the query filters only by project id, so it can return a project belonging to another workspace. Include the workspace predicate in the repository query.
listProjects accepts workspaceId but the query filters only by status, so it can list active projects from every workspace. Scope the list query by workspaceId as well.
renameProject accepts workspaceId but the update is constrained only by project id. Include the owning workspace in the update predicate to prevent cross-tenant modification.
